compact_chirality.theorem: On compact connected boundaryless M, harmonic exact 1-form df=0, via integral |df|²=integral f delta df=0
compact_chirality.nonexact_harmonic_1_cycle: constant x-edge flow on T3, divergence zero and not a gradient
compact_chirality.necessary_global_resolution: compact smooth globally exact harmonic Cartan background impossible except phi=0; preserving local -3 index requires compensating index, singularities/boundaries, or a different global twisted system
compact_chirality.limitations: The T3 graph is only a discrete illustration. Gauge-connection-valued harmonic Higgs fields, closed nonexact harmonic 1-forms, singular compactification, and source terms are not excluded.

SIC_flavor_and_AF_parent.SU9_flavor_no_go: For full global U(9) flavor invariance and fixed 3x9 frame QQdag=6I, right U9 acts transitively. Any U9-invariant potential cannot distinguish a SIC frame from a repeated-basis frame, so a preferred flavor basis or explicit symmetry breaking/couplings are necessary.
SIC_flavor_and_AF_parent.IR_baryon_as_deformation: B=Q^4 has dimension 18/5>3 in the undeformed SCFT, so its superpotential coupling is irrelevant. S*B is even more irrelevant for a decoupled free S. Relevant/marginal interactions can change the fixed point and must be analyzed.
SIC_flavor_and_AF_parent.limitations: The Seiberg SCFT analysis assumes ordinary massless SQCD with no vacuum-selecting superpotential, no weakly coupled Higgs VEV, and no accidental R mixing. U9 flavor is not a symmetry if explicit flavor-dependent Yukawas/targets are inserted.

curved_slice_gravity.no_go: Promoting q from external function to canonical variable without adding H_grav cannot make the matter HH bracket equal the FULL diffeomorphism constraint D_m+D_g. A complete gravitational Hamiltonian is necessary.
curved_slice_gravity.scope: This is a classical 1+1 matter-on-curved-spatial-slice benchmark, NOT Einstein gravity, not a 3+1 field-dependent canonical gravitational constraint calculation.

operational_memory.Hoeffding_assumptions: Independent Bernoulli trial success indicators; no hidden reference bypass, and Bell success evaluated on all heralded input trials with lost outputs scored zero
operational_memory.mixture_bound_assumption: Channel is c times ideal unitary quantum memory plus 1-c arbitrary entanglement-breaking; not a universal lower bound on quantum channel capacity.
operational_memory.single_photon_capacity: Faithful arbitrary n-qubit Hilbert-space encoding into a single one-excitation state with M orthogonal modes requires M>=2^n.
operational_memory.limits: No actual photonic data, no experimental loophole closure, no full hardware process tensor or fault-tolerant encoded T9 operation.

unification.SU5_complete_multiplet_no_go: Equal-threshold complete SU5 multiplets shift beta1,beta2,beta3 equally, so alpha_i^-1-alpha_j^-1 and one-loop crossing scales are unchanged.
unification.limitation: One-loop sharp spectrum benchmark only. Below-MZ fitted threshold is not physically an above-MZ MSSM threshold; realistic mass splittings, two-loop running, matching, proton-decay limits and GUT gravitational thresholds not included.

two_RH_neutrino_rank.source_mass_splittings: Bari preliminary 2026.a values reproduced from 8efe83ec model-independent report, not experimental inference from this script.
two_RH_neutrino_rank.cross_sector_caveat: Rank-two light neutrino mass matrix may be phenomenologically acceptable, unlike rank-two charged-fermion Yukawas leaving a massless charged family.
